topIssues.title: [Base Mainnet] BAD BLOCK, invalid gas used
topIssues.author: qnduncan
topIssues.body:
#### System information

Geth version: `us-docker.pkg.dev/oplabs-tools-artifacts/images/op-geth:v1.101609.0`
CL client & version: `us-docker.pkg.dev/oplabs-tools-artifacts/images/op-node:v1.16.5`
OS & Version: NA (running in containers)

#### Expected behaviour

The node is running on Base Mainnet. We expect op-geth can stay up to tip.

#### Actual behaviour

The node is running on Base Mainnet and op-geth is stuck at `43,504,471` due to `BAD BLOCK invalid gas used`.

#### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

NA
Many of our base mainnet op-geth full nodes were stuck at different heights near `43,504,000` due to `BAD BLOCK invalid gas used`.
